chan_doan.van_de: Nha may null qua nho de ket luan bat cu dieu gi ve cong
chan_doan.bang_chung: null_chi_tiet = 10 ca, 1 tai san (EURCAD), 1 khung (H4). Ty le lot 0/10 co khoang tin cay 95% la [0% ; 30,8%] — khong the phan biet 'cong hieu chuan o 5%' voi 'cong tu choi 100%'. Ban do gan nhat luc 2026-08-15 19:58, tuc 12,9 gio truoc anh chup nay, trong khi 275 gia thuyet da di qua cong.

chan_doan.van_de: Phan phoi p cua ung vien lech manh khoi null ma khong co gi ra khoi cong
chan_doan.bang_chung: ung_vien_n=275, p trung vi 0,325 (null ky vong 0,5), ty le p<0,05 = 18,18% (~50 ca) so voi 5% ky vong duoi null — thoi gap 3,6 lan. Cung luc ty_le_qua_cong = 0,0 va theo_verdict chi co FAIL:275. Hai kha nang loai tru nhau va CHUA phan biet duoc: (a) p-value bi thoi (bar chong lan / tu tuong quan / tai su dung mau), (b) co tin hieu that dang bi cong loai.

chan_doan.van_de: Co 1 gia thuyet vuot FDR nhung van bi cong loai — dau ra tang thong ke khong di duoc ra ngoai
chan_doan.bang_chung: fdr_da_bac_bo = 1 tren fdr_tong = 275, nhung theo_verdict = {FAIL: 275} va ty_le_qua_cong = 0,0. Ung vien duy nhat song sot hieu chinh da boi bi tang sau loai.

chan_doan.van_de: Mau thuan so lieu FDR giua cac tang dem
chan_doan.bang_chung: fdr_tong = 275 nhung fdr_tong_tho = 687, trong khi so_ket_qua_tho = 755. 687 khong khop voi bat ky moc nao khac (755 tho, 480 du phong, 275 ket qua; 480+275=755). Co mot tang dang dem tren tap 687 khong duoc dinh nghia o dau.

chan_doan.van_de: 63,6% ket qua di duong DU PHONG
chan_doan.bang_chung: so_ket_qua_du_phong = 480 / so_ket_qua_tho = 755. Chi 275 (36,4%) thanh ket qua duoc ket vao gia thuyet. Neu duong du phong doi tham so/du lieu thi 480 phep thu nay khong so sanh duoc voi 275 kia, va khong ro chung co bi tinh vao mau thu (multiple testing) hay khong.

chan_doan.van_de: Bang van de dang mo bi nhan ban va khong tu dong
chan_doan.bang_chung: 13 van de mo, trong do 3 cap trung noi dung: (7009967569 + f7f11f13ea) = 'null qua nho'; (5f7a8fa671 + ba1deaef7d) = 'phan phoi p lech khoi null'; (c17d82c8bb + 3c0a37d910) = 'cong loai het gia thuyet vuot FDR'. Ngoai ra llm_ce2c5af67a ghi 'MT5 tick-test dang bi khoa' trong khi mt5_tick_test = GO — trieu chung da het ma van de van mo.

chan_doan.van_de: Hai chan doan LLM cu con noi '8 gia thuyet da vuot FDR', so hien tai la 1
chan_doan.bang_chung: c17d82c8bb va 3c0a37d910 deu ghi 'ca 8 gia thuyet da vuot FDR', so lieu suc khoe hien tai fdr_da_bac_bo = 1. Mot trong hai la sai, va cac van de muc NANG dang duoc uu tien dua tren con so khong con dung.

chan_doan.van_de: Nguon 'semantic' bat nhung khong thu duoc gi va khong bao loi
chan_doan.bang_chung: semantic: {lan:1, loi:0, thu_hoach:0, trang_thai:'BAT'}. Sau 1 lan goi, 0 loi, 0 tai lieu — day la loi im lang, khac han arxiv 89 / openalex 146 / github 119 cung so lan goi.

chan_doan.van_de: Hang cho ton 175 viec trong khi QUANTLAB dang 'nghi'
chan_doan.bang_chung: viec.QUANTLAB = {CHO:175, XONG:755}, trang_thai 'nghi', tre_giay 120. viec_treo=0 va viec_loi=0 nen khong phai ket, nhung nang luc dang khong duoc dung het khi con 175 viec xep hang.

chan_doan.van_de: Dia con 15,4 GB — sat nguong theo bay da biet cua du an
chan_doan.bang_chung: dia_trong_gb = 15,4. Bay so 8 trong QUY_TRINH_MO_TAI_SAN ghi 'fetch MT5 lam day o dia'; day chuyen dang chay lien tuc voi 175 viec cho.

de_xuat.viec: Phong nha may null len toi thieu 200 ca, trai deu >=5 tai san x >=3 khung, va chay lai moi lan cham vao cong
de_xuat.vi_sao: 10 ca cho khoang tin cay rong 31 diem phan tram — rong hon chinh nguong 5% ma cong dang bao ve, nen so lieu null hien tai khong chung minh duoc gi. Voi 200 ca, mot cong dung o alpha=0,05 se cho ~10 ca lot; cong tu choi tat ca cho 0. Hai gia thuyet moi tach ra duoc.
de_xuat.kiem_the_nao: Tinh khoang Wilson 95% cua null_ty_le_lot. Yeu cau: bien tren < 0,10 thi moi duoc phat bieu ve hieu chuan. Neu lot = 0/200 (bien tren 1,9%) thi cong CHAT hon alpha danh nghia, phai bao cao alpha thuc te chu khong bao 'khong co edge'.

de_xuat.viec: Tha canary V6 THAT qua cong (IBS<0,2 VA bias>0, danh muc 3 chi so My, bar cat theo phien My), khong phai IBS don le tren mot symbol
de_xuat.vi_sao: Van de hieu_chuan_v6 da neu dung: ban thu 15/08 bi FAIL nhung do khong phai V6. V6 co Sharpe 0,95 do tren MT5 that — day la mau CO edge duy nhat da xac nhan. Cong loai mat V6 thi ty_le_qua_cong = 0 khong con y nghia gi.
de_xuat.kiem_the_nao: Chay V6 dung dac ta qua nguyen day chuyen. PASS -> cong lanh, 0% qua cong la ket luan that. FAIL -> ghi ro tang nao loai (p, FDR, placebo, WF, hay chi phi) va sua dung tang do.

de_xuat.viec: Kiem tinh dung cua p-value bang chinh day chuyen tren du lieu hoan vi KHOI
de_xuat.vi_sao: 18,18% ung vien co p<0,05 va p trung vi 0,325 — lech xa null dong deu. Neu p tinh dung thi day chuyen dang vut di tin hieu that; neu p bi thoi thi moi bang xep hang ung vien tu truoc den nay deu sai thu tu.
de_xuat.kiem_the_nao: Lay >=300 chuoi hoan vi theo khoi (giu cum che do, theo quy tac 19 va 28: hoan vi CHUOI VI THE, khong hoan vi chuoi lai/lo), chay het qua duong tinh p that. Kiem dinh KS voi U(0,1). p_KS < 0,01 => p-value cua he thong bi thoi, phai sua truoc khi tin bat ky con so nao.

de_xuat.viec: Mo ho so ung vien duy nhat vuot FDR va ghi ro tang nao loai no
de_xuat.vi_sao: fdr_da_bac_bo = 1 nhung ty_le_qua_cong = 0. Day la ca cu the, kiem duoc, cho cau hoi 'cong co qua chat khong' — re hon nhieu so voi tranh luan tren thong ke tong.
de_xuat.kiem_the_nao: In log tung tang cho ung vien do (p, q, placebo %, WF theo nam, chi phi thuc). Neu no chet o tang chi phi, doi chieu lai spread that 0,6-0,8 bps (muc 11) — nhieu ket luan 'chet vi cost' truoc 28/07 dung gia dinh cao gap 12 lan.

de_xuat.viec: Khu trung lap bang van de mo bang khoa noi dung va tu dong khi trieu chung het
de_xuat.vi_sao: 3/13 van de la ban sao, va llm_ce2c5af67a con mo trong khi mt5_tick_test da GO. Bang canh bao co nhieu muc NANG gia thi khong con dung de xep uu tien.
de_xuat.kiem_the_nao: Bam khoa = hash cua (loai_van_de, doi_tuong) thay vi hash noi dung sinh moi lan. Them dieu kien dong tu dong; sau mot vong, so van de NANG phai giam tu 8 xuong <=4.

de_xuat.viec: Dinh nghia va ghi log duong DU PHONG, va noi ro 480 ket qua nay co vao mau thu boi khong
de_xuat.vi_sao: 63,6% san luong di duong nay ma khong biet no khac gi duong chinh. Neu chung co tinh p ma khong vao mau FDR thi FDR dang bi tinh tren mau nho hon that -> ty le duong tinh gia cao hon bao cao.
de_xuat.kiem_the_nao: Doi chieu 480 vs 275 tren cung mot bo tieu chi. Neu duong du phong sinh p, cong 480 vao mau FDR va xem fdr_da_bac_bo doi the nao.

de_xuat.viec: Khai bao lab/config/nguong.json truoc khi chay them phep thu
de_xuat.vi_sao: He dang dung 0,05 mac dinh hoc thuat, khong phai nguong cua du an. Moi con so 'FAIL' hien tai deu treo tren mot mac dinh chua ai duyet.
de_xuat.kiem_the_nao: Sau khi khai bao, chay lai 275 ung vien voi nguong moi va so sanh ty_le_qua_cong. Neu ket qua doi -> nguong la yeu to quyet dinh chu khong phai du lieu.

de_xuat.vi_sao: Dang chiem mot khe goi va bao 'BAT' nhung dong gop 0/456 tai lieu, che dau mot loi im.
de_xuat.kiem_the_nao: Goi tay 1 truy van, in ma HTTP + so ban ghi. Neu 200 ma rong -> sai tham so truy van; neu 401/429 -> thieu key hoac bi chan, khi do chuyen sang duong trinh duyet nhu van de nguon_can_trinh_duyet da neu.

cau_hoi_cho_nguoi: Ba con so cua THIET_KE muc 11 (nguong) la bao nhieu? Chua co chung thi moi verdict FAIL hien nay chi la he qua cua mac dinh 0,05.
Duong 'du phong' sinh ra 480/755 ket qua la duong nao, khac duong chinh o cho nao, va co duoc dem vao mau hieu chinh da boi khong?
fdr_tong_tho = 687 dem tren tap nao? No khong khop 755 lan 275.
Cong PASS gom nhung tang nao va nguong tung tang? Hien chi thay p va FDR trong so lieu, nhung 1 ung vien vuot FDR van FAIL nen phai co it nhat mot tang nua khong duoc bao cao.
Danh sach canary biet-truoc-co-edge gom nhung gi ngoai V6? Can it nhat 3 mau duong va 3 mau am de do do nhay va do dac hieu cua cong.
p-value cua ung vien tinh tren bar chong lan hay bar roi nhau, va co hieu chinh tu tuong quan khong?
